blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Management Association of the Philippines had two honorees on Monday, and one was a birthday boy. As JG Summit president and CEO Lance Gokongwei marked his 60th birthday at Shangri-La The Fort, the whole room sang “happy birthday” to him. “Today, I’ve officially become a dual citizen,” Gokongwei quipped in his acceptance speech. “I’ve joined the senior citizen club. I know many of you are already members, although you certainly don’t look it.” Gokongwei shared the 2026 Management Person of the Year award with Phinma’s Chito Salazar.
